svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Experiment design: the only difference between the two arms
svg.desc: Two prompt stacks side by side. Both send the same neutral system frame and the same task; the guardrailed arm also appends the project's AGENT_RULES.md to the system prompt.
svg.text: The experiment in one picture: same model, same task, one extra file
Every task is generated twice per model and arm, with fixed seeds. Nothing else differs between the two arms.
BASELINE
what a developer who adds nothing gets
System prompt
Neutral engineering frame, identical in both arms
No rules file
no security instruction of any kind
User prompt
The task, e.g. “Create a Next.js route handler GET /api/invoices/[id]…”
GUARDRAILED
the same request with the project's rules
System prompt
Neutral engineering frame, identical in both arms
+ AGENT_RULES.md
about 2,127 tokens of security rules (web), 3,151 (mobile/desktop)
User prompt
The task, e.g. “Create a Next.js route handler GET /api/invoices/[id]…”
Held constant: temperature 0.7 · top-p 0.8 · top-k 20 · max 8,192 tokens · thinking off · identical frame and user prompt · randomised order, fixed seed.
